articles.title: Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
articles.excerpt: Google's stock dropped as much as ten percent after its quarterly earnings. Google acknowledged that its fast-growing AI mode brings in less revenue than traditional search, and it is now expanding its AI mode ad program internationally.
